<!--
Use this for how the project is RUN, not for what it does.

Examples that belong here:
- a role, permission or ownership question (maintainers, reviewers, CODEOWNERS)
- a policy that is missing, unclear, or contradicts what actually happens
- repository or subproject administration
- CNCF-related process

Bugs and features belong in cozystack/cozystack. Architectural changes belong in design-proposals as a PR.

To propose promoting someone to Reviewer or Maintainer, open a nomination issue in cozystack/cozystack instead — that is where MAINTAINERS.md and the ladder live.
-->

<!-- One or two sentences. What is wrong, missing, or ambiguous? -->

## Where it shows up

<!-- Link the document, file, repository setting or meeting where you hit this. If a written rule and reality disagree, link both. -->

## What you think should happen

<!-- Optional. A proposal helps, but reporting the problem is enough — you do not need a solution to open this. -->

<!-- Contributors, maintainers, adopters, a specific subproject? -->
